sql.b3_session_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE 
legs AS (
  SELECT actor_session_uid AS s, time_epoch AS t, dst_endpoint_hostname AS h, api_request_data AS d,
    CASE WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.fetch','issue.read','pr.read') THEN 1
         WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.search','contacts.list')
           OR (api_operation = 'file.read' AND (api_request_data LIKE '%/proc/self/environ%'
               OR api_request_data LIKE '%.env%' OR api_request_data LIKE '%credentials.json%')) THEN 2
         WHEN api_operation IN ('http.open','web.fetch') AND dst_endpoint_hostname NOT IN ('docs.python.org', 'github.com', 'api.github.com', 'pypi.org', 'intranet.example', 'wiki.example', 'calendar.example', 'mail.example', 'registry.example') THEN 3
    END AS leg
  FROM api)
SELECT s AS unit FROM legs WHERE leg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT leg) = 3 AND MAX(t) - MIN(t) <= 3600
sql.b4_session_sql_qualified:

  SELECT actor_session_uid AS s, time_epoch AS t, dst_endpoint_hostname AS h, api_request_data AS d,
    CASE WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.fetch','issue.read','pr.read') THEN 1
         WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.search','contacts.list')
           OR (api_operation = 'file.read' AND (api_request_data LIKE '%/proc/self/environ%'
               OR api_request_data LIKE '%.env%' OR api_request_data LIKE '%credentials.json%')) THEN 2
         WHEN api_operation IN ('http.open','web.fetch') AND dst_endpoint_hostname NOT IN ('docs.python.org', 'github.com', 'api.github.com', 'pypi.org', 'intranet.example', 'wiki.example', 'calendar.example', 'mail.example', 'registry.example') THEN 3
    END AS leg
  FROM api),
bursts AS (
  SELECT s, h FROM legs WHERE leg = 3 GROUP BY s, h HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND MAX(t) - MIN(t) <= 300),
qlegs AS (
  SELECT l.s, l.t, CASE WHEN l.leg = 3 AND NOT (l.d LIKE '%api03-%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bursts b WHERE b.s = l.s AND b.h = l.h))
                        THEN NULL ELSE l.leg END AS leg
  FROM legs l)
SELECT s AS unit FROM qlegs WHERE leg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT leg) = 3 AND MAX(t) - MIN(t) <= 3600

WITH RECURSIVE 
legs AS (
  SELECT actor_session_uid AS s, time_epoch AS t, dst_endpoint_hostname AS h, api_request_data AS d,
    CASE WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.fetch','issue.read','pr.read') THEN 1
         WHEN api_operation IN ('mail.search','contacts.list')
           OR (api_operation = 'file.read' AND (api_request_data LIKE '%/proc/self/environ%'
               OR api_request_data LIKE '%.env%' OR api_request_data LIKE '%credentials.json%')) THEN 2
         WHEN api_operation IN ('http.open','web.fetch') AND dst_endpoint_hostname NOT IN ('docs.python.org', 'github.com', 'api.github.com', 'pypi.org', 'intranet.example', 'wiki.example', 'calendar.example', 'mail.example', 'registry.example') THEN 3
    END AS leg
  FROM api),
parents AS (SELECT DISTINCT actor_session_uid AS s, delegation_parent_uid AS p FROM api),
walk AS (
  SELECT s, s AS root, 0 AS depth FROM parents WHERE p IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.s, w.root, w.depth + 1 FROM parents c JOIN walk w ON c.p = w.s WHERE w.depth < 8)
SELECT w.root AS unit FROM legs l JOIN walk w ON w.s = l.s WHERE l.leg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.root HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT leg) = 3 AND MAX(t) - MIN(t) <= 3600
